fault_name: Inner Race Micro-Spalling & Surface Fatigue
description: Sub-surface fatigue peeling propagating to surface spalling on the inner ring raceway.
spectral_signature: Prominent peaks at 1X BPFI harmonics (1x, 2x, 3x BPFI) modulated by 1X running speed sidebands (1X RPM).
acoustic_symptom: Rhythmic high-frequency clicking and ticking under heavy radial load.
root_causes: Excessive dynamic radial load
Shaft runout / eccentric fit
Lubrication starvation at high contact stress
immediate_action: Reduce machine load by 30%, schedule emergency replacement within 24-48 hours.
standard_operating_procedure:
1. Isolate and lock-out electrical feed.
2. Dismount bearing using hydraulic puller.
3. Measure shaft seat runout and tolerance (m5/k5).
4. Induction heat new bearing to 110°C and press to shoulder.
5. Apply prescribed grease quantity and perform baseline vibration run.

fault_name: Inner Race Fluting from Stray Shaft Current (Electrical Erosion)
description: Micro-cratering and washboard fluting lines caused by PWM VFD high-frequency discharge currents passing through the oil film.
spectral_signature: High frequency acceleration enveloping rise with sharp BPFI and harmonic clusters; high crest factor.
acoustic_symptom: High-pitched metallic buzzing / whining varying with VFD carrier frequency.
root_causes: Missing or worn shaft grounding ring
VFD common-mode voltage spikes
Uninsulated NDE bearing on inverter duty motor
immediate_action: Inspect shaft grounding brush, test shaft voltage, plan bearing change with ceramic coated (INSOCOAT) bearing.
standard_operating_procedure:
1. Test shaft-to-ground voltage using oscilloscope.
2. Replace bearing with hybrid ceramic ball or insulated outer ring bearing.
3. Install new Aegis shaft grounding ring.
4. Check inverter cable shielding and grounding bond.

fault_name: Inner Race Fretting Corrosion & Shaft Slip
description: Loose shaft fit causing micro-movement between bearing bore and shaft journal, generating reddish hematite oxide (fretting rust).
spectral_signature: Harmonics of 1X RPM with sub-synchronous 0.5X looseness harmonics and raised baseline noise.
acoustic_symptom: Chattering sound during acceleration and deceleration.
root_causes: Undersized shaft tolerance (loose fit)
Shaft journal fretting wear
Excessive vibrational excitation from driven load
immediate_action: Check shaft runout, inspect for rust discharge at shaft collar, prepare for sleeve repair or shaft metallizing.
standard_operating_procedure:
1. Measure shaft journal with micrometer.
2. If undersized >15 µm, apply brush plating/sleeving or Loctite 641 bearing retainer compound.
3. Install replacement bearing ensuring proper interference fit.

fault_name: Outer Race Stationary Spall & Pitting
description: Localized pitting and surface micro-chipping in the loaded zone of the stationary outer ring.
spectral_signature: Non-modulated sharp peaks at fundamental BPFO and its harmonics (2x BPFO, 3x BPFO, 4x BPFO) with minimal sidebands.
acoustic_symptom: Steady, rhythmic grinding noise synchronized with BPFO frequency.
root_causes: Material fatigue beyond rating life L10h
Excessive steady-state radial preload
Moisture ingress causing corrosion pit initiation
immediate_action: Initiate priority repair dispatch within 24 hours to prevent complete roller seizure.
standard_operating_procedure:
1. Lock out machine.
2. Disassemble bearing housing cover.
3. Clean and inspect housing bore for ovality or taper.
4. Fit new bearing and pack 30-50% free volume with specified grease.

fault_name: Outer Race False Brinelling (Stationary Vibration Wear)
description: Shallow indentations in raceways mirroring rolling element spacing, formed while the unit was stationary during adjacent machine vibrations.
spectral_signature: Multi-harmonic BPFO peaks coupled with low amplitude 1X baseline rumble.
acoustic_symptom: Rumbling drone that increases linearly with shaft speed.
root_causes: Standby machine exposed to heavy floor vibration from adjacent operating equipment
Inadequate transport/storage protection
immediate_action: Schedule vibration isolation pads installation and replace affected standby bearing.
standard_operating_procedure:
1. Replace bearing.
2. Implement periodic shaft rotation program (15 min monthly) for all standby fleet assets.
3. Install elastomeric damping pads under machine base.

fault_name: Outer Race Distortion from Housing Bore Pinching / Out-of-Round
description: Uneven radial clearance reduction caused by over-torqued housing split bolts or warped plummer block housing.
spectral_signature: Elevated 2x BPFO and 2X RPM harmonics due to two-lobe ovality squeeze.
acoustic_symptom: Dull groaning noise under load accompanied by elevated housing temperature.
root_causes: Overtightened housing cap bolts
Debris trapped under housing mounting feet (soft foot)
Machining error in housing bore
immediate_action: Loosen and re-torque housing bolts to manufacturer spec with calibrated torque wrench; check soft foot.
standard_operating_procedure:
1. Perform 0.05 mm feeler gauge soft-foot check under all mounting pads.
2. Use torque wrench to tighten housing bolts to specified Nm in cross pattern.
3. Verify unconstrained shaft rotation by hand.

fault_name: Ball / Roller Element Spalling & Flat Spots
description: Severe surface spalling, micro-welding, or flat spots on one or more rolling elements.
spectral_signature: Prominent Ball Spin Frequency (2x BSF) and Fundamental Train Frequency (FTF) sidebands with high impulsive crest factor.
acoustic_symptom: Erratic knocking and harsh clicking that fluctuates in tempo and volume.
root_causes: Hard foreign particle contamination
Skidding due to extremely light load at high RPM
Impact shock during mounting
immediate_action: Emergency shutdown within 6 hours to avoid catastrophic cage explosion and shaft lockup.
standard_operating_procedure:
1. Lock out power immediately.
2. Discard bearing and perform thorough solvent flush of housing and oil/grease channels.
3. Inspect shaft journal for gouging.
4. Install new bearing using approved induction heater (never hammer directly on rollers).

fault_name: Roller Element Skidding & Smearing (Inadequate Minimum Load)
description: Rolling elements slide and drag across the raceway instead of rolling pure, causing metal transfer and microscopic smearing tears.
spectral_signature: Broadband high-frequency noise floor lift (2 kHz - 10 kHz) with intermittent BSF bursts.
acoustic_symptom: Intermittent squealing / scraping noise under light load or during rapid acceleration.
root_causes: Bearing operating below catalog minimum load (P0 < 0.02 C)
Overly viscous grease at low ambient start-up
Excessive internal clearance (C4 instead of C3)
immediate_action: Adjust wave spring axial pre-load or switch to lower viscosity synthetic lubricant.
standard_operating_procedure:
1. Install axial pre-load spring disc to maintain continuous rolling element engagement.
2. Change grease to high-lubricity polyurea synthetic grease (e.g. Mobil Polyrex EM).

fault_name: Cage (Retainer) Pocket Wear & Fracture
description: Breakage of cage bridge or excessive pocket elongation, allowing rolling elements to bunch together.
spectral_signature: Dominant Fundamental Train Frequency (FTF) peak (~0.38 - 0.43X RPM) and multiple integer harmonics with heavy broadband hash.
acoustic_symptom: Violent rattling and loud metal clattering from bearing chamber.
root_causes: Severe vibration acceleration causing cage fatigue
Lubricant dry-out causing pocket friction
Excessive speed beyond cage limiting RPM
immediate_action: TRIP MACHINE IMMEDIATELY. Imminent total mechanical catastrophic seizure.
standard_operating_procedure:
1. Emergency stop.
2. Extract destroyed bearing.
3. Check housing alignment and bore geometry.
4. Upgrade replacement to machined brass cage (ECMA/M suffix) instead of pressed steel.

fault_name: Severe Lubrication Starvation (Dry Running)
description: Complete breakdown of hydrodynamic elastohydrodynamic (EHD) oil film, resulting in direct metal-to-metal boundary friction.
spectral_signature: Massive high-frequency ultrasonic elevation (>5 kHz), rising baseline carpet, followed by multi-frequency bearing defect peaks.
acoustic_symptom: Continuous piercing dry squeal and screeching.
root_causes: Missed regreasing interval
Grease canal blockage / dried soap hard cake
Purged grease through broken seals
immediate_action: Apply emergency grease injection slowly while monitoring temperature and acoustic level; if temp does not drop, shut down.
standard_operating_procedure:
1. Clear grease drain port.
2. Inject 50% calculated grease charge with hand gun.
3. Run machine for 30 minutes; if temperature rises above 95°C, stop and replace bearing.

fault_name: Over-Lubrication (Grease Churning & Overheating)
description: Excessive grease packed into bearing housing (100% full), forcing rolling elements to churn fluid, generating viscous shear heat.
spectral_signature: Elevated 1X RPM baseline rumble with no distinct defect frequencies; elevated low-frequency energy.
acoustic_symptom: Muffled hydrodynamic churning sound accompanied by greasy oozing around labyrinth seals.
root_causes: Operator over-greasing during routine PM
Blocked grease relief / purge valve
immediate_action: Open drain plug / relief valve to allow excess grease to escape under centrifugal action.
standard_operating_procedure:
1. Remove housing bottom drain plug.
2. Run motor for 45 minutes until grease stops extruding.
3. Verify temperature stabilizes back below 65°C.

fault_name: Abrasive Contamination & Particulate Ingress
description: Hard silica dust, slurry grit, or metal swarf particles entered bearing cavity through degraded seals, micro-denting raceways.
spectral_signature: Elevated high-frequency floor with diffuse random spikes across 2 kHz - 8 kHz (acoustic emission burst activity).
acoustic_symptom: Gritty scratching and sandpaper-like friction sound.
root_causes: Damaged V-ring / oil lip seal
Airborne dust in harsh plant environment
Dirty grease gun nozzle used during maintenance
immediate_action: Purge grease cavity with fresh grease until clean grease discharges; schedule seal replacement.
standard_operating_procedure:
1. Replace damaged mechanical/lip seals with heavy-duty SKF TK/Taconite seals.
2. Thoroughly flush housing and repack with fresh grease.
3. Mandate protective dust caps on all plant grease nipples.

fault_name: Lubricant Thermal Oxidation & Base Oil Degradation
description: Grease has turned black, hardened, and lost bleeding capability due to prolonged excessive thermal exposure.
spectral_signature: Progressive rise in high-frequency demodulation energy and sporadic low-level impact peaks.
acoustic_symptom: Dry friction hiss with periodic dull ticks.
root_causes: Incorrect grease selection (low drop point)
High ambient process temperature
Extended PM intervals beyond oil life curve
immediate_action: Perform full grease flush or oil change; upgrade to high-temperature synthetic lubricant.
standard_operating_procedure:
1. Purge out degraded black sludge completely.
2. Refill with high-temp polyurea synthetic grease (rated to 160°C).
3. Recalculate PM regreasing interval using Arrhenius temperature derating rule.

fault_name: Angular & Parallel Shaft Misalignment
description: Drive motor and driven machine centerlines are not collinear, causing severe asymmetric axial and radial cyclic loading.
spectral_signature: Dominant 2X RPM peak (often exceeding 1X RPM) in both radial and axial directions, with 180° phase shift across coupling.
acoustic_symptom: Low-frequency steady hum and pulsation at 2X shaft rotational speed.
root_causes: Thermal growth mismatch
Pipe strain or foundation settling
Improper laser alignment during installation
immediate_action: Check coupling flexibility, measure thermal growth, perform precision laser alignment at operating temperature.
standard_operating_procedure:
1. Perform laser shaft alignment.
2. Adjust stainless steel shims under motor feet until angular misalignment < 0.05 mm/100mm and offset < 0.05 mm.
3. Check coupling elastomer insert for gouging and replace if worn.

fault_name: Dynamic Rotor Unbalance
description: Mass center of rotating assembly does not coincide with geometric center of rotation, generating rotating centrifugal force.
spectral_signature: High amplitude sinusoidal peak strictly at 1X RPM in radial horizontal and vertical directions; 90° phase difference.
acoustic_symptom: Deep pulsating hum and strong floor vibration shaking base structure.
root_causes: Dust/material buildup on fan blades/impeller
Loss of balance balance weights
Uneven thermal deformation
immediate_action: Clean fan/impeller blades, check for foreign deposits, perform in-situ dynamic balancing.
standard_operating_procedure:
1. Clean rotor thoroughly with pressure wash.
2. Mount dual-channel vibration analyzer with optical tachometer.
3. Perform 2-plane dynamic field balancing to ISO 1940 Grade G2.5.

fault_name: Mechanical Looseness (Structural / Base Soft Foot)
description: Loose foundation anchor bolts, cracked concrete plinth, or distorted machine frame allowing rocking motion.
spectral_signature: Rich series of 1X, 2X, 3X, 4X, 5X, 6X RPM harmonics accompanied by 0.5X sub-harmonics.
acoustic_symptom: Dull thumping and rattles when machine transitions across resonant speeds.
root_causes: Loose base bolts
Foundation epoxy grout failure
Soft foot (angular or parallel air gap)
immediate_action: Check and torque all foundation hold-down bolts; re-shim soft foot corners.
standard_operating_procedure:
1. Use dial indicators on each foot while loosening bolts one by one.
2. Correct soft foot using precision pre-cut shims (target deflection <0.04 mm).
3. Re-torque bolts to grade specification.

fault_name: Excessive Axial Thrust Overload
description: High continuous axial load exerted onto deep groove or cylindrical roller bearing not designed to absorb primary thrust.
spectral_signature: High 1X RPM in axial direction coupled with deep groove raceway side shoulder wear tracks and elevated BPFI/BPFO.
acoustic_symptom: Strained whining and elevated motor power draw (amperage rise).
root_causes: Clogged pump balance line
Coupling axial binding (no float)
Reverse impeller pressure build-up
immediate_action: Check pump balance disk / balance pipe pressure, verify thermal expansion float gap on non-drive end bearing.
standard_operating_procedure:
1. Verify 2-3 mm axial clearance gap in NDE housing to accommodate thermal shaft expansion.
2. Clean pump impeller balance holes / balance pipe.
3. Replace bearing.

fault_name: Zero / Negative Internal Clearance (Over-Clamping / Tight Fit)
description: Oversized shaft seat or overdriven tapered sleeve reduced internal radial clearance to zero, resulting in roller jamming.
spectral_signature: Immediate high thermal runaway; elevated 1X, 2X harmonics and broad high-frequency friction noise.
acoustic_symptom: Tight metallic hum without distinct clicks; shaft hard to turn by hand during commissioning.
root_causes: Adapter sleeve driven up taper too far without feeler gauge check
Wrong clearance class installed (CN used instead of C3/C4)
immediate_action: Stop immediately to avoid shaft scoring and inner ring split.
standard_operating_procedure:
1. Dismount adapter sleeve.
2. Use feeler gauge blades to measure initial and final internal clearance during drive-up.
3. Ensure minimum residual clearance meets ISO/SKF standard (e.g. 0.045 - 0.060 mm for 22218 EK).

fault_name: Cocked / Tilted Ring Mounting (Out-of-Square)
description: Bearing ring seated skewed against shaft shoulder or housing shoulder due to burrs or out-of-square machining.
spectral_signature: Oval wear pattern traversing diagonally across raceway; dominant 1X and 2X axial vibration.
acoustic_symptom: Oscillating cyclic rub every revolution.
root_causes: Burr or metal chip trapped behind shaft shoulder
Fillet radius of shaft larger than bearing corner chamfer (r > r_b)
immediate_action: Disassemble and inspect shaft shoulder runout with dial gauge; dress shaft corner radius.
standard_operating_procedure:
1. Measure shaft shoulder squareness (perpendicularity < 0.02 mm).
2. Deburr shoulder and verify corner chamfer clearance.
3. Press new bearing flush against true shoulder.

fault_name: True Brinelling / Impact Shock During Mounting
description: Plastic indentations pressed into raceways by rolling elements when mounting force was transmitted through the rolling elements.
spectral_signature: Multi-harmonic BPFO and BPFI peaks with elevated impulsive peaks right from initial commissioning.
acoustic_symptom: Persistent rhythmic ticking starting from day one of startup.
root_causes: Direct hammer blows on outer ring while fitting onto shaft
Extreme shock load during crane transport
immediate_action: Plan replacement during upcoming planned maintenance window.
standard_operating_procedure:
1. Replace damaged bearing.
2. STRICT RULE: Always use induction heater or mounting sleeve that applies force ONLY to the interference-fit ring.

fault_name: Corrosion & Water Emulsification Wear
description: Water or chemical washdown ingress emulsified grease and etched black etch streaks and oxidation pits onto mirror raceways.
spectral_signature: Random broadband spikes with elevated carpet in 1 kHz - 5 kHz range; fast degradation of raceway profile.
acoustic_symptom: Rough abrasive rasping and grinding.
root_causes: High-pressure water jet spray directed at bearing seals during plant cleaning
Condensation in humid unvented housing
immediate_action: Drain water-contaminated milky grease immediately; install protective deflector flinger disc.
standard_operating_procedure:
1. Flush bearing housing.
2. Install water-resistant calcium-sulfonate complex grease (e.g. SKF LGWA 2).
3. Fit rubber V-ring flinger over shaft to deflect direct water spray.

fault_name: High Ambient Heat & Thermal Clearance Loss
description: High temperature from process/furnace transferred along shaft causing inner ring thermal expansion greater than outer ring expansion.
spectral_signature: High overall vibration, continuous thermal rise towards 100°C+, elevated 1X baseline.
acoustic_symptom: Stressed humming and heat radiation from housing.
root_causes: Missing shaft cooling fan / heat dissipation disc
Improper clearance rating (C3 required for high delta-T)
immediate_action: Install auxiliary cooling blower; verify lube oil flow and temperature.
standard_operating_procedure:
1. Replace bearing with C3 or C4 radial internal clearance model.
2. Install shaft heat flinger disc.
3. Use high-temperature synthetic ester/fluorinated lubricant.

fault_name: Contact Seal Degradation & Lip Friction Burn
description: Nitrile/FKM rubber seal lip hardened, cracked, or grooved the shaft, allowing lubricant leak and dirt ingress.
spectral_signature: High-frequency friction squeal (8 kHz - 15 kHz) with minimal low-frequency vibration.
acoustic_symptom: Intermittent high-frequency seal whistle/squeak.
root_causes: Dry seal lip running without lubrication film
Shaft surface roughness too high (Ra > 0.8 µm)
immediate_action: Apply grease film to seal lip; replace worn seal during next scheduled stop.
standard_operating_procedure:
1. Install new double-lip nitrile seal packed with grease between lips.
2. Polish shaft seal track to Ra 0.2 - 0.4 µm.
3. Ensure seal lip faces toward lubricant retention.

fault_name: Pump Cavitation / Flow Turbulence Shock on Bearings
description: Hydraulic vapor bubble collapse in pump volute induces severe random shock impulses through shaft directly into bearing rings.
spectral_signature: Broadband high-frequency 'haystack' hump between 1 kHz and 8 kHz with random shock transients.
acoustic_symptom: Loud crackling and popping sound like gravel passing through the pump.
root_causes: Inlet suction valve throttled (insufficient NPSH_a)
Clogged suction strainer
Operating pump far to the right of BEP (Best Efficiency Point)
immediate_action: Check suction pressure and suction strainer; open suction valve fully; adjust discharge flow to BEP.
standard_operating_procedure:
1. Inspect and clean suction basket strainer.
2. Verify suction tank level and positive NPSH margin.
3. Perform vibration test after hydraulic flow stabilization.

fault_name: Gear Mesh Impact Transmission to Pinion Bearing
description: Gear tooth pitting or chipped tooth in gearbox generates high-amplitude mesh impact forces transmitted into pinion support bearing.
spectral_signature: Gear Mesh Frequency (GMF = Teeth x RPM) and sidebands modulated by 1X pinion RPM affecting bearing envelope.
acoustic_symptom: High-pitched gear whine modulated by cyclical clunking.
root_causes: Gear misalignment
Lube contamination in gearbox sump
Severe shock load during mill startup
immediate_action: Inspect gearbox inspection hatch; check magnetic drain plug for metal shards; sample gear oil.
standard_operating_procedure:
1. Inspect gear teeth with borescope.
2. Replace chipped gear set and adjacent damaged pinion bearings.
3. Flush gearbox sump and refill with fresh ISO VG 320 gear oil.

fault_name: Combined Inner & Outer Race Advanced Spallation
description: Widespread spallation on both inner and outer raceways; metal debris circulating in ball path.
spectral_signature: Simultaneous strong BPFI and BPFO harmonic peaks with overlapping sidebands and broad elevated noise floor.
acoustic_symptom: Loud continuous harsh grinding and crunching.
root_causes: End-of-life fatigue failure
Operation under severe contamination and misalignment
immediate_action: EMERGENCY SHUTDOWN. Stop machine immediately to prevent shaft weld and fire hazard.
standard_operating_procedure:
1. Isolate machine immediately.
2. Replace complete bearing set and seals.
3. Inspect shaft seat and housing bore with CMM/micrometer.
4. Commission with new baseline vibration spectrum.

fault_name: Lubrication Failure Cascaded into Outer Race Seizure
description: Thermal seizure where outer race spun in housing bore following lubricant dry-out and micro-welding.
spectral_signature: Severe high baseline vibration, multiple harmonics, temperature exceeding 110°C.
acoustic_symptom: Extreme screeching followed by smoke emission from seal labyrinth.
root_causes: Complete grease depletion combined with high radial load
immediate_action: TRIP UNIT. Fire watch protocol if grease smoking.
standard_operating_procedure:
1. Shut down and allow cooldown.
2. Remove melted/destroyed bearing.
3. Machine/sleeve housing bore if scored.
4. Install new bearing with automatic lubricator system (e.g. SKF SYSTEM 24).

fault_name: Structural Resonance Amplification at Bearing Housing
description: Operating speed or 2X speed coincides with natural frequency of machine skid/pedestal, causing extreme vibration amplification.
spectral_signature: Very high 1X or 2X peak that drops drastically (>70%) when speed is changed by even 3-5%.
acoustic_symptom: Loud resonant droning echoing through building structure at specific RPM.
root_causes: Skid structural stiffness inadequate
Variable frequency drive tuned to resonant speed band
immediate_action: Program skip frequency band (notch filter) in VFD (e.g. 48 Hz - 51 Hz).
standard_operating_procedure:
1. Perform impact bump test to identify natural frequency modal peaks.
2. Add structural gussets/stiffeners to machine pedestal.
3. Lock out critical speed range in VFD parameter p1091 (Skip frequency).

fault_name: Excessive V-Belt Tension Overloading Motor DE Bearing
description: Drive belts over-tightened during belt change, placing continuous massive radial side load on drive-end bearing.
spectral_signature: Elevated 1X RPM radial peak aligned with belt pull direction; early onset of BPFO and inner race fatigue.
acoustic_symptom: Strained motor groaning and hot DE bearing housing.
root_causes: Pry-bar belt tensioning without sonic belt tension meter check
immediate_action: Slack off belt tension adjustment screws immediately to prescribed Hz/Newton tension.
standard_operating_procedure:
1. Measure belt span frequency with sonic tension meter (e.g. Gates 508C).
2. Adjust motor slide base until strand frequency matches calculated value.
3. Re-verify DE bearing temperature.

fault_name: Coolant / Glycol Ingress Emulsification in Circulating Oil
description: Heat exchanger tube leak allowed water-glycol coolant to mix into lube oil reservoir, collapsing oil film thickness.
spectral_signature: Rapid rise in high-frequency kurtosis followed by multiple bearing defect harmonics across all compressor bearings.
acoustic_symptom: Hissing and milky oil appearance in sight glass with foaming.
root_causes: Ruptured cooler bundle gasket or tube corrosion in lube oil cooler
immediate_action: Switch to standby compressor; sample oil; isolate lube cooler water supply.
standard_operating_procedure:
1. Pressure test lube oil cooler bundle (hydrotest at 6 bar).
2. Drain contaminated oil and replace filter elements.
3. Perform oil flush with flushing oil before refilling with fresh synthetic charge.
